plan: The dominant strategy in this auction is to bid 50% of your value. While this isn't always optimal due to risk aversion and the behavior of other players, it's a strong baseline, especially in a single round. Given my value of $35, 50% is $17.50. I will bid $17.50. This minimizes the risk of overpaying while still giving me a reasonable chance of winning if others bid low.

The dominant strategy in this second-price sealed-bid auction is to bid 50% of my value. This is because my profit is (value - second highest bid) if I win, and 0 if I lose. Bidding 50% ensures I win if and only if my value is higher than the second highest value, and I pay a price close to the true market value. With a value of $32, 50% is $16.

The dominant strategy in this second-price sealed-bid auction is to bid 50% of your value. This is because you want to win only when the value exceeds your bid (and the second-highest bid). Bidding 50% accomplishes this. My value is $48, so 50% is $24. I will bid $24. This maximizes my expected profit in the long run, independent of the other bidders' strategies.
